title: Evidence assistant
notADecision: A comparison to help you, not a decision: it blocks nothing, and you decide.

states.possible_difference: possible difference (> tolerance — take a look)
states.periodShift: period shift — balanced by the neighbouring invoice

invoiceLevel: This invoice's rows in all packages: {litres} L {fuel}
otherLines: Other lines on the invoice (not compared)
buyer: Buyer as printed (display only, never checked): {name}
sharedNote: This invoice is split across {count} accounts
noVisibleSiblings: The other packages of this invoice are not in your access.

unreadReasons.no_text: The PDF holds no text (a scan or a photo).
unreadReasons.encrypted: The PDF is protected by a password.
unreadReasons.unreadable: The file could not be read.
unreadReasons.unreadable_row: A row of the invoice could not be read together with its product.
unreadReasons.limit_exceeded: The file is beyond the reader's limits.
unreadReasons.timed_out: Reading the file took too long.
unreadReasons.reader_busy: Another invoice is being read: open the package again in a moment.
unreadReasons.reader_unavailable: The reader is not available in this environment.
unreadReasons.unknown_series: The invoice is not of a known series (OZK, DAU).
unreadReasons.no_matching_invoice: None of the attached files holds this package's invoice.
unreadReasons.several_matching_invoices: The attached files hold more than one invoice for this package.

split.attachedOne: Split by invoice: attached to 1 package.
split.attachedMany: Split by invoice: attached to {count} packages.

reasons.no_eligible_batch: no open package of yours bears this number
reasons.manual_attachment_required: attach the PDF to its own package
reasons.unverified_part: its pages could not be checked

split.failed: Some packages could not receive their invoice: attach the same PDF again to finish.
